svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · NATIVE SPEECH-TO-SPEECH VS. CASCADED ASR+LLM+TTS (#368)
Moshi / Qwen2.5-Omni (RVQ Codec) vs. Streaming ASR + vLLM + CosyVoice2
Hybrid Thinker-Talker Omni delivers 235 ms full-duplex voice response while preserving 96.4% enterprise tool accuracy
Tier 2 vs. Tier 3: The Voice Architecture Dilemma
but strips user tone/emotion (18%) during text bottleneck
• Tier 3 (Pure S2S Moshi): 195ms latency & 95% emotion, but acoustic
tokens degrade complex RAG/SQL tool calling down to 78.5%!
• Thinker LLM: Processes raw audio/video embeddings + executes
deterministic RAG / JSON tool calls + emits text audit stream
• Talker Dual-Track AR: Consumes Thinker hidden states Directly to
stream 12.5Hz RVQ audio in 235 ms with 96.4% tool accuracy!
4-Tier Voice AI Paradigm Matrix (200 Concurrent Voice Sessions · NVIDIA H100 80GB)
Tier 1 (Batch Turn-Based Cascade) : Latency = 2150ms | Tool Acc = 96.5% | Emotion = 5% | Cap = 18 sess/GPU
Tier 2 (Streaming Clause Cascade) : Latency = 480ms | Tool Acc = 96.8% | Emotion = 18% | Cap = 42 sess/GPU
Tier 3 (Pure Native S2S Moshi) : Latency = 195ms | Tool Acc = 78.5% | Emotion = 95% | Cap = 36 sess/GPU
Tier 4 (Hybrid Thinker-Talker Omni): Latency = 235ms | Tool Acc = 96.4% | Emotion = 92% | Cap = 48 sess/GPU
